dict.string: SplitDeck asks Music or Spotify for artwork and playback control, asks your browser which tab is playing so it can show the video thumbnail, and, for Quick Toggles, uses System Events to switch dark mode.
SplitDeck reads unread badge counts from app icons in the Dock. It does not read notification content.
SplitDeck shows battery levels for your connected Bluetooth devices.
SplitDeck uses your location for local weather when you choose Precise location.

SplitDeck shows your favourite photos in the Photo Frame widget.
